theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_cyl_fubini
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} ∧ (∀ f : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable f → ∫⁻ z in {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A}, f z = ∫⁻ u in A, ∫⁻ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, f (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)))) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ, IntegrableOn f {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} → ∫ z in {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A}, f z = ∫ u in A, ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, f (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)))
